content:
Hello,

Given the new HTTP feature, i implemented a file serving facility in LeanIO.
For that i need a file seeking feature (move the File cursor to a position).
Currently i'm reading chunks of the file and trash them to move the File Handle Cursor because it looks like the current IO.Fs.Handle API don't have a way to move the internal File Cursor.
Am i looking at the wrong place ? Because maybe the IO.FS.Handle being generic is not the proper way to access the File API ? If so do you have any pointers ?
This is a known gap that will be worked on in upcoming stdlib changes.

Thank you. i'll wait patiently as i have a workaround for now!
I know the todo list is huge. keep the good work.
